about: Short release notes for the Android app's update popup, newest first. A few bullets per version; the full notes are in VERSIONS.md. Add the new version here with each release.

versions.title: Practice sheets, Undo, and flashcards for tablets
notes: Print practice sheets with squares to write in (⋮ → Practice sheet), or save them as PDF
Flashcards: Undo brings back the card you just rated
Tablets and landscape: characters on the left, meaning and examples on the right

versions.title: Choose your tone colours
notes: Setting up the full app starts by choosing tone colours, with red · green · blue · purple recommended

versions.title: New icon
notes: The app icon shows 華, the first character of 華語練習

versions.title: A fairer first choice
notes: First launch: beginner mode and the full app are two equal choices, each listing what it includes

versions.title: Measure words and a better grammar quiz
notes: Grammar: a new 量詞 Measure words section, with tables and its own quiz
Grammar quiz: wrong options are now words of the same kind, so you have to think
Beginner mode: a banner with a button to switch to the full app
This popup: release notes for every version you've missed

versions.title: New Culture tile
notes: The Culture tile shows 臺 (Taiwan), since Culture now holds slang, Taiwanese and history too

versions.title: Steadier reading filters
notes: Reading: the filters are three equal buttons that stay in place

versions.title: Engineering levels and Dark grey
notes: Reading: engineering passages have their own level menu
Options → Appearance: a new Dark grey theme

versions.title: Colloquial phrasebook for beginners
notes: Beginner mode: a Colloquial tile with 25 everyday Taiwan phrases
Numbers and money moved into the Phrasebook

versions.title: Reading
notes: New: Reading, 110 short passages at every level, with questions afterwards
Culture has tabs: food and culture, 口語 Colloquial, 台語 Taiwanese and History
174 colloquial words and a Taiwanese pronunciation guide
